title: He hasn't been served yet. He will be served soon.
translation: 还沒有人来招待他。很快会有人来招待他的。
description: A picture lesson on the present perfect passive and the future passive. Eight pictures show 'hasn't been done yet' questions and their answers: hasn't anyone repaired this car yet / it has already been repaired; hasn't anyone corrected these exercise books yet / they have already been corrected; hasn't anyone caught the thief yet / he hasn't been caught yet, he will be caught soon; hasn't anyone caught the thieves yet / they haven't been caught yet, they will be caught soon. The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 143 story), B (answer questions imitating the example, 'someone has done it / it has already been done'), and C (answer questions imitating the example, 'it hasn't been done yet, it will be done tomorrow'). The workbook drills passive dialogues ('It hasn't been done yet, but it will be done soon') and open-ended situations; the grammar workbook answers questions with 'No, not yet, but ... will be ...' and 'No, it/they has/have only just been ...'. This is the final lesson of Book 1.
answer_note: The listening captions are model answers (suggested). Textbook written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 143 story), B (answer imitating the example), and C (answer imitating the example) are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (complete the dialogues) and B (situations) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-141-144.jpg p.217-218). Grammar I (answer 'No, not yet, but ... will be ...') and II (answer 'No, it/they has/have only just been ...') are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.580).

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
lesson.context: One question per picture (8 pictures); the answer is the passive sentence shown in the picture captions.

questions.prompt: Picture 1: Hasn't anyone repaired this car yet?
questions.answer: No. It hasn't been repaired yet. / It has already been repaired.

questions.prompt: Picture 2: Has the car been repaired?
questions.answer: Yes. It has already been repaired.

questions.prompt: Picture 3: Hasn't anyone corrected these exercise books yet?
questions.answer: No. They haven't been corrected yet. / They have already been corrected.

questions.prompt: Picture 4: Have the exercise books been corrected?
questions.answer: Yes. They have already been corrected.

questions.prompt: Picture 5: Hasn't anyone caught the thief yet?
questions.answer: No. He hasn't been caught yet. He will be caught soon.

questions.prompt: Picture 6: Has the thief been caught?
questions.answer: No. He hasn't been caught yet. He will be caught soon.

questions.prompt: Picture 7: Hasn't anyone caught the thieves yet?
questions.answer: No. They haven't been caught yet. They will be caught soon.

questions.prompt: Picture 8: Have the thieves been caught?
questions.answer: No. They haven't been caught yet. They will be caught soon.

lesson.title: Written A: Answer the questions (about Lesson 143)
lesson.instruction: Read the piece in Lesson 143 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 143 课课文，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 重读第 143 课课文，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 8 comprehension questions about the Lesson 143 story (A walk through the woods).

questions.prompt: Where does the writer live?
questions.answer: He lives in a very old town.

questions.prompt: Why do visitors often come from the city?
questions.answer: They come to see the town and to walk through the woods.

questions.prompt: What have visitors been asked to do?
questions.answer: They have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.

questions.prompt: Where have litter baskets been placed?
questions.answer: They have been placed under the trees.

questions.prompt: Where did the writer go last Wednesday?
questions.answer: He went for a walk in the woods.

questions.prompt: He saw a lot of rubbish, didn't he?
questions.answer: Yes, he did.

questions.prompt: What did he see among the rubbish?
questions.answer: He saw seven old cars and three old refrigerators.

questions.prompt: What did the sign say?
questions.answer: It said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'

lesson.title: Written B: Answer the questions (imitate the example)
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions imitating the example. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 2 printed examples (Hasn't anyone opened the window yet? → Someone has opened it. It has already been opened. / Hasn't anyone opened the windows yet? → Someone has opened them. They have already been opened.) + 10 practice items.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone opened the window yet?
questions.answer: Someone has opened it. It has already been opened.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone opened the windows yet?
questions.answer: Someone has opened them. They have already been opened.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone aired this room yet?
questions.answer: Someone has aired it. It has already been aired.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone cleaned these rooms yet?
questions.answer: Someone has cleaned them. They have already been cleaned.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone emptied this basket yet?
questions.answer: Someone has emptied it. It has already been emptied.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone sharpened this knife yet?
questions.answer: Someone has sharpened it. It has already been sharpened.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone turned on the taps yet?
questions.answer: Someone has turned them on. They have already been turned on.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone bought these models yet?
questions.answer: Someone has bought them. They have already been bought.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone swept the floor yet?
questions.answer: Someone has swept it. It has already been swept.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone taken them to school yet?
questions.answer: Someone has taken them. They have already been taken to school.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone invited them yet?
questions.answer: Someone has invited them. They have already been invited.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone told them yet?
questions.answer: Someone has told them. They have already been told.

lesson.title: Written C: Answer the questions (imitate the example)
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions imitating the example. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 2 printed examples (Hasn't anyone opened the window yet? → It hasn't been opened yet. It will be opened tomorrow. / Hasn't anyone opened the windows yet? → They haven't been opened yet. They will be opened tomorrow.) + 10 practice items.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone opened the windows yet?

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone emptied this basket yet?
questions.answer: It hasn't been emptied yet. It will be emptied tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone sharpened this knife yet?
questions.answer: It hasn't been sharpened yet. It will be sharpened tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone turned on the taps yet?
questions.answer: They haven't been turned on yet. They will be turned on tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Hasn't anyone watered these flowers yet?
questions.answer: They haven't been watered yet. They will be watered tomorrow.

practice.title: Practice A: It hasn't been done yet, ... (complete the dialogues)
practice.instruction: Look at this and then complete the dialogues below, like the example. 模仿例句完成以下对话。
practice.translation: 模仿例句完成以下对话。
practice.context: 6 dialogue items with a present-perfect / future-passive reference table (Active/Passive, Present perfect / Future with will); item 1 (Has my watch been repaired yet? (soon) → No, I'm sorry. It hasn't been repaired yet, but it will be repaired soon.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: A: Has my watch been repaired yet? (soon)
questions.answer: No, I'm sorry. It hasn't been repaired yet, but it will be repaired soon.

questions.prompt: A: Have those letters been typed yet? (this afternoon)
questions.answer: No, I'm sorry. They haven't been typed yet, but they will be typed this afternoon.

questions.prompt: A: Has my room been tidied yet? (at the weekend)
questions.answer: No, I'm sorry. It hasn't been tidied yet, but it will be tidied at the weekend.

questions.prompt: A: Have the children been invited to the party yet? (next week)
questions.answer: No, I'm sorry. They haven't been invited yet, but they will be invited next week.

questions.prompt: A: Has John been told yet? (tomorrow)
questions.answer: No, I'm sorry. He hasn't been told yet, but he will be told tomorrow.

questions.prompt: A: Have those jobs been finished yet? (by 6 o'clock)
questions.answer: No, I'm sorry. They haven't been finished yet, but they will be finished by 6 o'clock.

practice.title: Practice B: Situations (what might you say?)
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What might you say in each? 为以下情景写出正确的应答。
practice.translation: 为以下情景写出正确的应答。
practice.context: 3 open-ended situation-response items; the workbook key gives model answers.

questions.prompt: You left your shoes at a shop to be repaired. What do you say when you walk in to ask if they have been repaired yet?
questions.answer: Have my shoes been repaired yet?

questions.prompt: Someone asks you if the litter baskets have already been emptied yet. You know they've already been done. What do you say?
questions.answer: They've / They have already been emptied.

questions.prompt: Someone has asked you to do something. How do you promise that it'll be done soon?
questions.answer: It will / It'll be done soon.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Answer the questions according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.580 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 present-perfect-passive question items answered with 'No, not yet, but ... will be ...'; item 1 (Has the new hospital been built yet? (next year) → No, not yet, but it will be built next year.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Has the new hospital been built yet? (next year)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but it will be built next year.

questions.prompt: Have you been served yet? (soon)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but I/we will be served soon.

questions.prompt: Has your homework been checked yet? (soon)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but it will be checked soon.

questions.prompt: Have the books been returned yet? (tomorrow)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but they will be returned tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Have the stamps been put on the envelopes yet? (soon)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but they will be put on the envelopes soon.

questions.prompt: Have you been introduced to the new students yet? (soon)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but I/we will be introduced to them soon.

questions.prompt: Has she been invited to the dance yet? (soon)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but she will be invited to it soon.

questions.prompt: Has my bike been repaired yet? (this afternoon)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but it will be repaired this afternoon.

questions.prompt: Have the letters been posted yet? (in five minutes' time)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but they will be posted in five minutes' time.

questions.prompt: Has the table been cleaned yet? (in a minute)
questions.answer: No, not yet, but it will be cleaned in a minute.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Answer the questions according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.580 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 past-passive question items ('Was/Were ... a long time ago?') answered with 'No, it/they has/have only just been ...'; item 1 (Was the old part of the city changed a long time ago? → No, it has only just been changed.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Was the old part of the city changed a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, it has only just been changed.

questions.prompt: Were many old houses repaired a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, they have only just been repaired.

questions.prompt: Were all the businesses started a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, they have only just been started.

questions.prompt: Was the cinema built a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, it has only just been built.

questions.prompt: Were all the schools set up a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, they have only just been set up.

questions.prompt: Was the college opened a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, it has only just been opened.

questions.prompt: Was the big supermarket built a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, it has only just been built.

questions.prompt: Were the parks opened a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, they have only just been opened.

questions.prompt: Were litter baskets put here a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, they have only just been put here.

questions.prompt: Was the town hall built a long time ago?
questions.answer: No, it has only just been built.
